verdict.rationale: Square exposes granular APIs (Catalog, Inventory, Orders, Locations, Payouts) that a developer could use to programmatically retrieve most of their business data, giving a technical path to export, but there is no documented single 'export all your data' feature, open-format bulk export tool, or account-closure data portability guarantee. missing for 10: a dedicated full-account data export/download feature, explicit open-format (CSV/JSON) bulk export documentation, and any statement about data portability upon leaving the platform.
